description: DISA STIG and SRG Baseline Checklist Catalog for Cloud Enclave Authorization. Official DISA source: https://public.cyber.mil/stigs/ (Note: stigviewer.com is an unofficial third-party mirror provided for reference only).

cloud_computing_mo_os_srg.title: DISA Cloud Computing Mission Owner Operating System Security Requirements Guide (SRG)
cloud_computing_mo_os_srg.scope: Mission Owner Operating System SRG (V1R3) responsibilities for cloud enclaves, host configuration guardrails, and organization policies (inherited Cloud Service Provider responsibilities are assessed under DISA Cloud Service Provider SRG V1R7).
cloud_computing_mo_os_srg.action: Complete DISA Cloud Computing Mission Owner Operating System SRG checklist (.ckl); verify Assured Workloads boundary guardrails and organization policy constraints.

cloud_computing_mo_network_srg.title: DISA Cloud Computing Mission Owner Network Security Requirements Guide (SRG)
cloud_computing_mo_network_srg.scope: Mission Owner Network SRG (V1R2) responsibilities for cloud enclave VPC topology, boundary segmentation, and network access controls (inherited CSP responsibilities assessed under DISA CSP SRG V1R7).
cloud_computing_mo_network_srg.action: Complete DISA Cloud Computing Mission Owner Network SRG checklist (.ckl); verify VPC network boundaries, ingress/egress routing, and perimeter segmentation.

canonical_ubuntu_2204_lts.title: DISA Canonical Ubuntu 22.04 LTS STIG
canonical_ubuntu_2204_lts.scope: Hardened Ubuntu 22.04 LTS Linux Compute Engine instances and build worker bastions.
canonical_ubuntu_2204_lts.action: Complete Canonical Ubuntu 22.04 LTS STIG CKL; apply Ubuntu Security Guide (USG) DISA profile in STIG Viewer desktop app.

canonical_ubuntu_2004_lts.title: DISA Canonical Ubuntu 20.04 LTS STIG (Sunset)
canonical_ubuntu_2004_lts.scope: Legacy Ubuntu Linux 20.04 LTS instances (Sunset by DISA on 2025-10-01; migrate to Ubuntu 22.04 LTS or 24.04 LTS STIG).
canonical_ubuntu_2004_lts.action: Migrate legacy Ubuntu 20.04 LTS instances to an actively supported LTS release and complete Canonical Ubuntu 22.04 LTS or 24.04 LTS STIG CKL.

canonical_ubuntu_2404_lts.title: DISA Canonical Ubuntu 24.04 LTS STIG
canonical_ubuntu_2404_lts.scope: Hardened Ubuntu 24.04 LTS host compute instances.
canonical_ubuntu_2404_lts.action: Complete Canonical Ubuntu 24.04 LTS STIG CKL; apply DISA profile in STIG Viewer.

red_hat_enterprise_linux_9.title: DISA Red Hat Enterprise Linux 9 STIG
red_hat_enterprise_linux_9.scope: Hardened Red Hat Enterprise Linux 9 Compute Engine VM hosts and administrative bastions.
red_hat_enterprise_linux_9.action: Complete Red Hat Enterprise Linux 9 STIG CKL; apply OpenSCAP/Ansible DISA STIG baseline.

red_hat_enterprise_linux_10.title: DISA Red Hat Enterprise Linux 10 STIG
red_hat_enterprise_linux_10.scope: Hardened Red Hat Enterprise Linux 10 Compute Engine VM hosts and administrative bastions.
red_hat_enterprise_linux_10.action: Complete Red Hat Enterprise Linux 10 STIG CKL; apply OpenSCAP/Ansible DISA STIG baseline.

red_hat_enterprise_linux_8.title: DISA Red Hat Enterprise Linux 8 STIG (Sunset)
red_hat_enterprise_linux_8.scope: Legacy Red Hat Enterprise Linux 8 instances (Sunset by DISA on 2026-09-30; migrate to RHEL 9 or RHEL 10 STIG).
red_hat_enterprise_linux_8.action: Migrate legacy RHEL 8 instances to RHEL 9 or RHEL 10 and complete the corresponding active DISA RHEL STIG CKL.

almalinux_os_9.title: DISA Cloud Linux AlmaLinux OS 9 STIG
almalinux_os_9.scope: Hardened AlmaLinux OS 9 Compute Engine VM instances.
almalinux_os_9.action: Complete DISA Cloud Linux AlmaLinux OS 9 STIG CKL; apply OpenSCAP DISA STIG baseline.

debian_linux.title: DISA General Purpose Operating System Security Requirements Guide (SRG)
debian_linux.scope: General-purpose Linux host instances (such as Debian, Rocky Linux, or Container-Optimized OS) where no vendor-specific DISA STIG exists.
debian_linux.action: Complete DISA General Purpose Operating System SRG CKL; apply OS security hardening baseline.

ms_windows_server_2022.title: DISA Microsoft Windows Server 2022 STIG
ms_windows_server_2022.scope: Hardened Microsoft Windows Server 2022 Compute Engine instances and Active Directory bastions.
ms_windows_server_2022.action: Complete Microsoft Windows Server 2022 STIG CKL; apply DISA GPO baseline in STIG Viewer desktop app.

ms_windows_server_2025.title: DISA Microsoft Windows Server 2025 STIG
ms_windows_server_2025.scope: Hardened Microsoft Windows Server 2025 Compute Engine instances and Active Directory bastions.
ms_windows_server_2025.action: Complete Microsoft Windows Server 2025 STIG CKL; apply DISA GPO baseline in STIG Viewer desktop app.

ms_windows_server_2019.title: DISA Microsoft Windows Server 2019 STIG (Sunset)
ms_windows_server_2019.scope: Legacy Microsoft Windows Server 2019 Compute Engine instances (Sunset by DISA on 2026-07-01; migrate to Windows Server 2022 or 2025 STIG).
ms_windows_server_2019.action: Migrate legacy Windows Server 2019 instances to Windows Server 2022 or 2025 and complete the active DISA Microsoft Windows Server STIG CKL.

suse_linux_enterprise_server.title: DISA SUSE Linux Enterprise Server 15 STIG
suse_linux_enterprise_server.scope: Hardened SUSE Linux Enterprise Server 15 instances.
suse_linux_enterprise_server.action: Complete SUSE Linux Enterprise Server 15 STIG CKL; apply OpenSCAP baseline.

cisco_ios_xe_router.title: DISA Cisco IOS XE Router RTR STIG
cisco_ios_xe_router.scope: Cisco IOS XE virtual edge router instances, IPsec transport encryption, and perimeter routing appliances.
cisco_ios_xe_router.action: Complete Cisco IOS XE Router RTR STIG CKL; verify MACsec / IPsec encryption and control plane policing.

network_infrastructure_policy_stig.title: DISA Network Infrastructure Policy STIG
network_infrastructure_policy_stig.scope: Network infrastructure policy architecture, routing protocol security, and boundary segmentation.
network_infrastructure_policy_stig.action: Complete DISA Network Infrastructure Policy STIG CKL; verify routing plane authentication and perimeter segmentation.

kubernetes.title: DISA Kubernetes STIG
kubernetes.scope: GKE private clusters, master control plane endpoints, RBAC, and Kubernetes cluster hardening.
kubernetes.action: Complete DISA Kubernetes STIG CKL; audit master authorized networks and Pod Security Standards in STIG Viewer.

container_platform_srg.title: DISA Container Platform Security Requirements Guide (SRG)
container_platform_srg.scope: Container platform runtimes, serverless container workloads, Cloud Run service perimeters, and container image registries.
container_platform_srg.action: Complete DISA Container Platform SRG CKL; enforce VPC-SC perimeter on Cloud Run services and verify non-root container execution.

docker_enterprise.title: DISA Docker Enterprise 2.x Linux/UNIX STIG (Sunset)
docker_enterprise.scope: Container base images, Dockerfile hardening, and non-root execution (Sunset by DISA on 2024-07-24; evaluate modern container runtimes against DISA Container Platform SRG).
docker_enterprise.action: Complete DISA Container Platform SRG CKL; eliminate root user in Dockerfiles and verify artifact signing.

crunchy_data_postgres_16.title: DISA Crunchy Data Postgres 16 STIG
crunchy_data_postgres_16.scope: Cloud SQL for PostgreSQL and AlloyDB instances, pgAudit logging, and TLS in transit (assessed via DISA Crunchy Data Postgres 16 STIG and Database SRG).
crunchy_data_postgres_16.action: Complete DISA Crunchy Data Postgres 16 STIG CKL; configure pgAudit database flags and verify Cloud Logging sink.

postgresql_13.title: DISA Crunchy Data PostgreSQL STIG (Sunset)
postgresql_13.scope: Legacy PostgreSQL instances (Sunset by DISA on 2026-07-01; assess modern PostgreSQL workloads under DISA Crunchy Data Postgres 16 STIG).
postgresql_13.action: Complete DISA Crunchy Data Postgres 16 STIG CKL; configure pgAudit database flags and verify Cloud Logging sink.

oracle_mysql_8.0.title: DISA Oracle MySQL 8.0 STIG
oracle_mysql_8.0.scope: Cloud SQL MySQL 8.0 database instances and secure transport enforcement.
oracle_mysql_8.0.action: Complete DISA Oracle MySQL 8.0 STIG CKL; enforce require_secure_transport and audit logging.

mariadb_enterprise_10x.title: DISA MariaDB Enterprise 10.x STIG
mariadb_enterprise_10x.scope: MariaDB Enterprise 10.x database instances, audit plugin logging, and TLS transport enforcement.
mariadb_enterprise_10x.action: Complete DISA MariaDB Enterprise 10.x STIG CKL; enforce TLS transport and MariaDB Audit Plugin logging.

ms_sql_server_2016_instance.title: DISA Microsoft SQL Server 2016 Instance STIG
ms_sql_server_2016_instance.scope: Cloud SQL for SQL Server 2016/2019 database instances (assessed via DISA Microsoft SQL Server 2016 Instance & Database STIGs and Database SRG).
ms_sql_server_2016_instance.action: Complete Microsoft SQL Server 2016 Instance STIG CKL; configure Windows Authentication / Cloud IAM and TLS encryption.

ms_sql_server_2022_instance.title: DISA Microsoft SQL Server 2022 Instance STIG
ms_sql_server_2022_instance.scope: Cloud SQL for SQL Server 2022 database instances.
ms_sql_server_2022_instance.action: Complete Microsoft SQL Server 2022 Instance STIG CKL; configure Windows Authentication / Cloud IAM and TLS encryption.

oracle_database_19c.title: DISA Oracle Database 19c STIG
oracle_database_19c.scope: Oracle Database 19c instances and Transparent Data Encryption (TDE).
oracle_database_19c.action: Complete DISA Oracle Database 19c STIG CKL; enforce unified auditing and secure connection strings.

oracle_database_12c.title: DISA Oracle Database 12c STIG (Sunset)
oracle_database_12c.scope: Legacy Oracle Database 12c instances (Sunset by DISA on 2025-07-08; migrate to Oracle Database 19c STIG).
oracle_database_12c.action: Migrate legacy Oracle 12c instances to Oracle 19c and complete DISA Oracle Database 19c STIG CKL.

database_srg.title: DISA Database Security Requirements Guide (Database SRG)
database_srg.scope: Managed database and data warehouse services (Cloud Spanner, BigQuery, Memorystore, Firestore) where no product-specific DISA STIG exists.
database_srg.action: Complete DISA Database SRG CKL; enforce TLS in transit, CMEK encryption at rest, and private IP connectivity.

mongodb_enterprise_advanced_7x.title: DISA MongoDB Enterprise Advanced 7.x STIG
mongodb_enterprise_advanced_7x.scope: MongoDB Enterprise Advanced 7.x document database instances, WiredTiger encryption, and SCRAM authentication.
mongodb_enterprise_advanced_7x.action: Complete DISA MongoDB Enterprise Advanced 7.x STIG CKL; enforce role-based access control and TLS transport.

mongodb_enterprise_advanced_8x.title: DISA MongoDB Enterprise Advanced 8.x STIG
mongodb_enterprise_advanced_8x.scope: MongoDB Enterprise Advanced 8.x document database instances, WiredTiger encryption, and SCRAM authentication.
mongodb_enterprise_advanced_8x.action: Complete DISA MongoDB Enterprise Advanced 8.x STIG CKL; enforce role-based access control and TLS transport.

mongodb_enterprise_3.x.title: DISA MongoDB Enterprise Advanced 3.x STIG (Sunset)
mongodb_enterprise_3.x.scope: Legacy MongoDB Enterprise Advanced 3.x instances (Sunset by DISA on 2024-07-24; migrate to MongoDB Enterprise Advanced 7.x or 8.x STIG).
mongodb_enterprise_3.x.action: Migrate legacy MongoDB 3.x instances to MongoDB 7.x or 8.x and complete the active DISA MongoDB Enterprise Advanced STIG CKL.

storage_area_network_san_srg.title: DISA Storage Area Network (SAN) STIG (Sunset)
storage_area_network_san_srg.scope: Legacy physical/virtual Storage Area Network fabrics (Sunset by DISA on 2025-01-30; cloud object storage is assessed under DISA Cloud Computing Mission Owner SRG).
storage_area_network_san_srg.action: Evaluate cloud object storage controls against DISA Cloud Computing Mission Owner SRG; verify public access prevention and CMEK encryption.

firewall_srg.title: DISA Firewall Security Requirements Guide (SRG)
firewall_srg.scope: VPC Hub/Spoke perimeter firewall policy tiers, default-deny ingress, and Cloud IAP bastions.
firewall_srg.action: Complete DISA Firewall SRG CKL; verify default-deny ingress rule and zero 0.0.0.0/0 exposure.

vpn_gateway_srg.title: DISA Virtual Private Network (VPN) Security Requirements Guide (SRG)
vpn_gateway_srg.scope: Cloud HA VPN gateways, IPsec cryptographic profiles, and BGP dynamic routing.
vpn_gateway_srg.action: Complete DISA Virtual Private Network (VPN) SRG CKL; enforce IKEv2 and AES-GCM 256-bit encryption cipher suites.

web_application_firewall_srg.title: DISA Application Layer Gateway (ALG) Security Requirements Guide (SRG) (WAF Functional Mapping)
web_application_firewall_srg.scope: Functional mapping to DISA Application Layer Gateway (ALG) SRG for Cloud Armor WAF policies, DDoS adaptive protection, and OWASP Top 10 rule sets (DISA does not publish a standalone WAF SRG).
web_application_firewall_srg.action: Complete DISA Application Layer Gateway (ALG) SRG CKL; verify pre-configured OWASP CRS rules and rate-limiting policies.

application_security_and_development_sti.title: DISA Application Security and Development (ASD) STIG
application_security_and_development_sti.scope: DevSecOps CI/CD pipelines, container vulnerability scanning, and OWASP application defenses.
application_security_and_development_sti.action: Complete DISA Application Security and Development (ASD) STIG CKL; incorporate automated SAST and container scanning in CI/CD pipeline.

apache_server_2.4_unix_server.title: DISA Apache Server 2.4 UNIX Server STIG
apache_server_2.4_unix_server.scope: Apache HTTP Server 2.4 on UNIX instances (for NGINX, use DISA F5 NGINX STIG; for other web servers, use DISA Web Server SRG).
apache_server_2.4_unix_server.action: Complete DISA Apache Server 2.4 UNIX Server STIG CKL; disable weak TLS ciphers, server tokens, and enforce HTTP security headers.

f5_nginx.title: DISA F5 NGINX STIG
f5_nginx.scope: NGINX HTTP/HTTPS web servers and reverse proxy instances.
f5_nginx.action: Complete DISA F5 NGINX STIG CKL; enforce TLS 1.2/1.3 cipher suites, disable server tokens, and configure HTTP security headers.

web_server_srg.title: DISA Web Server Security Requirements Guide (SRG)
web_server_srg.scope: Self-managed HTTP/HTTPS web server and reverse proxy workloads where no vendor-specific DISA STIG exists.
web_server_srg.action: Complete DISA Web Server SRG CKL; disable weak TLS ciphers, server tokens, and enforce HTTP security headers.
